en.headline: Two school buses collide in Ngau Chi Wan; 13 injured including children
en.dek: A white school bus carrying kindergarten pupils hit a parked yellow school bus outside a school on Jat Shan Road shortly after 1.20pm; all injuries were reported as minor.
body: Police said two school buses collided outside a school on Jat Shan Road in Ngau Chi Wan on Wednesday afternoon, leaving about 13 people with minor injuries, including several young children.

The incident occurred at about 1.26pm near Nos. 381–383 Jat Shan Road, outside Good Hope School and Kindergarten. According to initial reports, a white school bus carrying kindergarten pupils was suspected of losing control while turning and struck the rear of a parked yellow school bus. The yellow bus was pushed forward and struck people nearby.

The driver of the white bus had a foot trapped and was freed by firefighters. Injured parties included the driver, a nanny, school staff and pupils. All were reported to have sustained minor injuries and were taken to United and Kwong Wah hospitals for checks. Police said the children had no obvious external injuries.
Traffic officers are investigating the cause of the collision. The school declined immediate comment when contacted.

zh.headline: 牛池灣扎山道兩校巴相撞 約13人輕傷包括學童
zh.dek: 白色校巴載有幼稚園學童疑失控撞向停泊的黃色校巴，司機腳部一度被困，全部傷者輕傷送院。
body: 警方表示，周三下午牛池灣扎山道一間學校外兩輛校巴相撞，約13人輕傷，當中包括多名學童。
事發於下午約1時26分，扎山道381至383號德望小學暨幼稚園對開。初步消息指，一輛載有幼稚園學童的白色校巴疑掉頭時失控，車頭撞向停泊在前方的黃色校巴車尾，黃色校巴被推前並撞到附近人士。
白色校巴司機腳部被困，由消防員以工具救出。傷者包括司機、保姆、職員及學童，全部輕傷，分別由救護車送往聯合醫院及廣華醫院治理。據悉學童沒有表面傷。
交通警員在場調查意外原因。校方暫未回應查詢。
